summary: Energetic, Bilingual Human Resources Professional offering ~11 years of extensive and successful experience administering various HR plans and procedures. Emphasis on recruitment/retention, management and HR principles & practices. Expertise in employee relations and organization development through education, and experience, seeks a similar role to produce immediate growth contribution to a rewarding company.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Developed HR policies, procedures, plans and budgets.
Ensured workforce safety and managed recruitment, development, and compensation.
Built an employee‑oriented culture focused on quality, continuous improvement and high performance.
Conducted new employee orientation to foster positive attitudes toward organizational objectives.
Acted as liaison between management and employees, handling questions, interpreting contracts, and resolving work‑related problems.
Served on the executive management team, advising on compensation, benefits, compliance, organizational development, HRIS, training & development, and employee relations.
Reviewed and commented on documents, taking steps to cure deficiencies.
Created and implemented exit and interview program processes.
Ran bi‑weekly payroll.
Increased employee base by 15% to meet staffing needs.
